title: Search misses titles when the query has capital letters
goal: People find an item whichever way they type its title.

acceptance_criteria.text: A search ignores letter case in the query and in the title, for every letter and not only A to Z (reported: q=Report finds nothing although an item is titled Quarterly Report; ÉTÉ must find été).

A search ignores the Unicode form: a character written as one code point matches the same character written as a letter and a combining mark, and full-width letters and digits match half-width ones (ＡＢＣ１２３ and abc123).
Titles are stored and returned exactly as they were entered: searching changes no item. Searches for CJK text work as they do today.
Tests fail without the fix, for AC1 and for AC2.

context.notes: Find the cause. Keep node:http only; no dependencies.
